title: What is the difference of the average ball control score between Abdou Dial
question:
What is the difference of the average ball control score between Abdou Diallo and Aaron Appindangoye
?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: difference of the average ball control = SUBTRACT(AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'), AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye')); AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'XX XX') = SUM(CASE WHEN player_name = 'XX XX' THEN ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN player_name = 'XX XX' THEN id ELSE NULL END)

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  (
    SELECT AVG(pa.XCL_140)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
    WHERE p.XCL_123 = 'Abdou Diallo'
  )
  -
  (
    SELECT AVG(pa.XCL_140)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
    WHERE p.XCL_123 = 'Aaron Appindangoye'
  ) AS difference

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.XCL_146 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
     / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN pa.XCL_128 ELSE NULL END)) -
  (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.XCL_146 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
     / COUNT(CASE WHEN p.XCL_123 = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN pa.XCL_128 ELSE NULL END))
FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE p.XCL_123 IN ('Abdou Diallo','Aaron Appindangoye');
